title: Vessel from Gran Canaria
description: A wide body, a short neck and two raised, pierced lugs. The band of triangles follows the motif on the passport badge.
adaptations: Shallow engraving represents the painted decoration on the badge. The holes taper to a point at the top to make printing without supports easier.

title: Incised vessel from La Palma
description: A vessel with a rounded body and rim. The incisions on the shoulder, central band of short marks and paired strokes on the body follow the badge.
adaptations: The flat base and shallow incisions allow the vessel to print upright without supports.

title: Vessel from Lanzarote
description: A wide-mouthed vessel with two incised bands of diagonal strokes. Its light colour in the viewer recalls tegue, the traditional coating described in the infographic.
adaptations: The base is flat and the engraving is shallow. The STL reproduces the shape of the vessel. The viewer shows its light finish.

title: Tofio from Fuerteventura
description: A traditional milking vessel. Its low body, wide open spout and bands of incisions follow the badge.
adaptations: The spout widens gradually and joins the bowl. The flat base allows the vessel to print upright without supports.

title: Bowl from La Gomera
description: A shallow bowl with a wide opening and a slightly uneven rim. Its smooth outline without handles follows the passport badge.
adaptations: The flat base and the shape of the lower body make printing without supports easier. The thickness and small irregularities in the rim were adjusted for the model.
documentedDimensions: Dimensions estimated from the scale drawing of the bowl from Los Riscos del Paridero (Erque), p. 125, fig. 24.1.
referenceLabel: Navarro Mederos, Los gomeros, p. 125, fig. 24.1

title: Vessel from El Hierro
description: The low profile, thick rim and two short handles come from the photograph that inspired the badge. The infographic documents pottery fragments from El Hierro.
adaptations: The model has a wider base and smoother joins between the handles and body so it can print upright without supports.
